description.en: Forgot to subtract the ratio term from 1, using the raw compression-ratio term as the efficiency itself.
description.et: Unustas lahutada suhte liikme 1-st, kasutades toorest kompressiooniastme liiget kasutegurina endana.

description.en: Flipped the sign of the exponent, using (gamma minus 1) instead of (1 minus gamma).
description.et: Vahetas astendaja märgi, kasutades (gamma miinus 1) asemel (1 miinus gamma).

description.en: Used the heat capacity ratio alone as the exponent, forgetting to subtract it from 1 first.
description.et: Kasutas erisoojuste suhet üksi astendajana, unustades selle enne 1-st lahutada.
